say:2:1560304001:1.text: Whew... a full night's rest really makes a difference! So, where are we headed today?
say:2:1560304001:1.source_cn: 呼……休息了一夜，感觉精神多了！主人，我们今天先去哪里呢？

say:4:1560304002:1.text: If we're going there, Chippy wants... uh... roasted chicken, stuffed tomato rolls, and maybe wheat bread...
say:4:1560304002:1.source_cn: 如果要去圣石镇的话，满满想顺便买点秘制烤鸡、番茄酿肉卷...

say:6:1560304003:1.text: Chippy, that's too much. How are you planning to carry all that?!
say:6:1560304003:1.source_cn: 满满，买这么多要拿不下啦！

narration:7:1560304004:1.text: Surrounded by chatter and laughter, you return to Holistone. The familiar sights come into view one by one...
narration:7:1560304004:1.source_cn: 在欢声笑语中，你们回到了圣石镇。熟悉的景象出现在眼前……

say:8:1560304005:0.text: This is where your journey began, after all. So much has happened here.
say:8:1560304005:0.source_cn: 还记得冒险的启程吗？你曾在这里经历过许多。
say:8:1560304005:0.male: This is where your journey began, after all. So much has happened here.
say:8:1560304005:0.female: This is where your journey began, after all. So much has happened here.

say:10:1560304006:0.text: Vendors call out their wares, people chat in the streets, colorful ribbons sway from rooftops—the whole place feels livelier than usual, as if the festival spirit arrived early.
say:10:1560304006:0.source_cn: 喧嚣的叫卖声，欢声笑语的人群，人们将彩带挂上屋檐。圣石...

say:11:1560304007:0.text: Peace like this never comes without a price. There are always those who stir up trouble... and others who quietly take care of it before anyone notices.
say:11:1560304007:0.source_cn: 当然，这样和平安定的气氛来之不易。总有人想从中作梗，也...

say:13:1560304008:1.text: Hey there, friend. Offloading stolen goods this early in the day?

say:17:1560304010:1.text: Friendly tip: Next time, grow a few more eyes. Check whether someone's tailing you before you start dealing.
say:17:1560304010:1.source_cn: 奉劝一句，下次做事的时候，记得多长只眼睛，留意一下自己...

say:18:1560304011:1.text: Leaving the tavern... whispering about "classified plans"... a bit careless, don't you think?
say:18:1560304011:1.source_cn: 无论是从酒馆接头离开时……还是和内部讨论“机密”的时候。

say:19:1560304012:1.text: Are you saying... we have a mole?!
say:19:1560304012:1.source_cn: 你……你说我们内部有叛徒？！

say:20:1560304013:0.text: Didn't say that. Just making small talk. You're awfully jumpy for someone claiming innocence.
say:20:1560304013:0.source_cn: 我可没这么说，先生。只是一句顺口说的玩笑话，你可真没幽默感。

say:23:1560304014:0.text: Damn it... he saw everything. Fine. No point hiding it now.
say:23:1560304014:0.source_cn: 该死……都被他看到了。既然这样，就没办法了。

say:24:1560304015:0.text: Say your last words. Maybe you should've been the one growing extra eyes—you didn't even notice we had you surrounded.
say:24:1560304015:0.source_cn: 说遗言吧。怪就怪在你也没有“多长只眼睛”，没发现我们的...

say:28:1560304017:0.text: Valen, all right, fun's over. Let's handle the real business.
say:28:1560304017:0.source_cn: 维伦，玩笑话到此为止吧，该干正事了。

say:32:1560304019:0.text:
You...!
Get them! Kill them all!
say:32:1560304019:0.source_cn: 你们……！\n伙计们，给我上，杀了他们！

choice_prompt:33:1560304019.text:
You...!
Get them! Kill them all!
choice_prompt:33:1560304019.source_cn: 你们……！\n伙计们，给我上，杀了他们！

say:34:1560304020:0.text: Well now... didn't expect to see you here.
say:34:1560304020:0.source_cn: 哇哦……是你。这的确是我没料到的。
say:34:1560304020:0.male: Well now... didn't expect to see you here.
say:34:1560304020:0.female: Well now... didn't expect to see you here.

say:38:1560304021:1.text: Good to see you, old friend, though this isn't the best time for catching up. Come on, fight with us like the old days!
